About.title: About BookVra
About.p1: BookVra is a scheduling tool built for solo professionals — coaches, tutors, trainers, therapists, consultants, and anyone else who earns a living through one-on-one sessions.
About.p2: The problem we're solving is simple: managing bookings over WhatsApp, email, or DMs is painful. You spend more time coordinating than working. BookVra gives you a public booking page where clients can see your real availability and book in seconds — no back-and-forth required.
About.p3: We built BookVra as a focused, no-nonsense tool. You set your schedule, share your link, and we handle the rest — confirmation emails, calendar management, and keeping track of who's coming.
About.p4: BookVra is currently free and early-stage. We're building in public and talking to real professionals to make sure we solve the right problems.
About.contact: Have feedback, questions, or want to work with us?

sections.title: 1. What we collect
sections.intro: When you create an account with BookVra, we collect:
items: Your name and email address
Your Google profile information (if you sign in with Google)
Profile information you provide: bio, speciality, tagline, username
Booking data: appointment times and notes

sections.title: 2. How we use your data
sections.intro: We use your data exclusively to provide the BookVra service:
items: To display your public booking page to potential clients
To send booking confirmation emails to you and your clients
To manage your schedule and appointment history
To authenticate you when you sign in
sections.note: We do not sell your data. We do not share it with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: 3. Third-party services
sections.intro: We use the following services to run BookVra:
items: Resend — for sending transactional emails
Neon — for database hosting
Vercel — for application hosting
Google OAuth — for optional Google sign-in
sections.note: These providers are contractually obligated to protect your data.

sections.title: 4. Public information
sections.body: If you are a professional, your name, speciality, tagline, bio, and booking availability are displayed publicly on your booking page. This is the core functionality of the service. You can edit or remove this information at any time from your profile settings.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
items: Access the data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate data
Request deletion of your account and data
sections.note: To exercise any of these rights, email us at hello@bookvra.com.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance
sections.body: By creating an account or using BookVra ("the Service"), you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.

sections.title: 2. Description of service
sections.body: BookVra provides professionals with a public booking page where clients can view availability and schedule appointments. The Service is provided free of charge during the current phase.

sections.title: 3. Your account
items: Maintaining the security of your account credentials
All activity that occurs under your account
Providing accurate information in your profile
Honouring appointments you accept through the Service

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
items: Use the Service for any unlawful purpose
Impersonate another person or entity
Upload malicious content or attempt to compromise the Service
Create fake profiles or bookings
Use the Service to spam or harass other users

sections.title: 5. Bookings and appointments
sections.body: BookVra facilitates scheduling between professionals and clients. We are not a party to any service agreement between a professional and their client. Professionals are solely responsible for the services they provide.

sections.title: 6. Termination
sections.body: You may delete your account at any time by contacting us. We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

sections.title: 7. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. We'll notify registered users by email before significant changes take effect.
